page.overview:
Who is Shimmering Liquid?

The Shimmering Liquid is a fictional entity created by American author and games designer Kevin A. Ross for the role-playing game Call of Cthulhu. It first appeared in "Thunder in the Blood", a scenario included in the supplement End of the World (Triad Entertainments, 1994).

The Shimmering Liquid is one of five Lesser Other Gods from the Court of Azathoth that appeared during a summoning of Azathoth near San Lucas. It appears as a fully plastic but slightly translucent and shimmering liquid that is constantly changing shape while absorbing all manner of victims, no matter their form or size. (: End of the World)
